0f9708ac-aa21-5f63-9ec6-58447a7fc92d.content: The user stores wrapping paper and empty gift boxes on the upper shelf of the bedroom closet.

02cc21e8-122b-5246-acd6-e4601fde6278.content: From photographs, the user discovered that they had given their mother the same type of kitchen item two years in a row.

f062b340-5f2b-5a90-9c42-6864f8e942fe.content: This year, the user went to the market with their mother and let her choose a needed item directly.

e34becb2-5562-551d-9590-f48de6c3c8f4.content: The user once ordered a gift late and had it delivered the day after the gathering.

61e6ba24-1dfd-58fa-9128-b614ec392928.content: The next year, the user checked the expected delivery date and ordered one week before the gathering.

791daf99-b62e-5811-8ae9-ed7a5de9d879.content: The user did not put names on wrapped boxes and handed their older sister and younger brother each other's gifts.

3496cc32-6063-58ae-a123-01ab1fa14156.content: The next time the user wrapped gifts, they wrote the recipient on the bottom of each box.

b0f451fe-d208-5040-b8e7-1f59470f183a.content: The user's younger brother welcomes a snack the family can share immediately more than an item for his use alone.

96f8a998-afb3-53f9-880c-a8e9903b6810.content: The local agent can find past gift records and flag duplicates but cannot know what is needed this year.

4327f5b8-1093-55a2-968c-0cc32b43128b.content: Year-end deliveries may take longer than usual or have their expected dates changed.
